summary: Full backend + frontend smoke testing of 3D Print Vault app. 11/11 backend pytest cases passed (auth, projects CRUD, search, favorites, payments, upload guards). All 5 frontend pages render correctly with dark purple+blue theme (Landing, Dashboard, Upload, Favorites, Payments). Auth gating via session cookie works (seeded session redirected unauthenticated pages correctly).

minor.issue: Auth via ?auth= query param accepts raw token in URL (security risk - tokens may leak via logs/referrer). Prefer signed URLs.
No validation that emergent session-data call succeeded with expected fields; broad except Exception masks real errors.
view_count increments on every GET including from owner/bots - no de-dup.

issues: Missing data-testid on most interactive elements (upload-button, favorites-link, logout-button, payments-link, project-card, title-input, description-input, tags-input, thumbnail-input, files-input, submit-button, plan cards, assinar-agora buttons). Only search-input has testid. This hampers reliable automated testing.

action_items: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements in Dashboard, Upload, Favorites, Payments and ProjectDetail pages for testability
Consider replacing query-param token auth on /api/files/{path} with signed/short-lived URLs
Tighten error handling in /api/auth/session (avoid catching bare Exception)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 536 lines and mixes auth/projects/files/favorites/payments/webhook in a single module - should be split into routers per resource
get_current_user duplicated boilerplate at every protected endpoint - extract as FastAPI Depends
Webhook endpoint accepts events but never updates payment_transactions - implement event-driven status updates instead of relying on client polling
init_storage uses a module-level global mutable storage_key without locking; benign in single-process but worth noting
Stripe test key 'sk_test_emergent' returned 200 here but is clearly a placeholder - confirm with main agent before going live
test_credentials: Seeded test user/session via mongosh in test_database (auto-cleaned). For browser tests: cookie session_token used.
seed_data_creation: Created test_user + user_sessions docs in MongoDB test_database during fixture setup, cleaned up after.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_3d_vault.py covers auth/projects/favorites/payments/upload. Real Google OAuth and Stripe checkout completion cannot be tested end-to-end without real credentials/card - those flows were verified up to redirect URL creation only. ProjectDetail page was not visited (no projects in DB). File upload via Object Storage was not executed (only auth guard tested) to avoid noise in storage.
